title: Contact in the Desert appearances, replacing Jim Marrs

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. I was initially invited long ago to replace somebody I think and uh then I was invited to replace Jim Mars who was sick that year

plain: The author and historian Peter Levenda says he was invited to speak at Contact in the Desert, a UFO conference, as a stand-in. He tells Michels he was first asked long ago to replace someone. Then, around 2017, he was asked to step in for another speaker, Jim Marrs, who was sick that year.
